title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official: Anthropic’s managed Claude plugin directory
friendlyTitle: Anthropic’s official directory adds tools to Claude Code
summary: This official Anthropic-managed repository collects plugins for extending Claude Code with specialised tools and workflows. It had about 34,000 stars when reviewed, remained highly active, and was one of the day’s notable AI-related Python repositories.
friendlySummary: This repository contains official plugins that give Claude Code extra tools and workflows. It is managed by Anthropic.
whyItMatters: Claude Code users can browse maintained plugins instead of assembling every integration from scratch, while developers can study real plugin structures and conventions. As with any agent extension, review permissions and source code before granting access to sensitive systems.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Browse it when you want to add a feature to Claude Code, but check what access each plugin needs before installing it.
